open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmations
open_points.question: What facts constitute a pending confirmation, and does a session hold one pending confirmation in total, one per action, or several concurrently?
options: One pending confirmation for the whole session
One pending confirmation per confirmation-requiring action
Several independently identified pending confirmations
open_points.default_guess: One pending confirmation for the whole session, replaced when another confirmation is prepared.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending-confirmation lifecycle
open_points.text: “each kept until used, replaced or the session ends”
open_points.question: Which product actions create, read, replace and consume pending confirmation values, and does an attempted but refused confirmed action consume them?
options: Preparing a confirmation creates or replaces them, and any confirmed attempt consumes them
Preparing creates or replaces them, but only an accepted action consumes them
Each confirmed product action defines its own consumption rule
open_points.default_guess: Preparing a confirmation replaces the existing values, and any confirmed attempt consumes them.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession import upload
open_points.text: M11 makes “the import file uploaded in it” an OwnerSession fact, while M10 says “nothing else of the migration is a Registry record”.
open_points.question: Is the uploaded import file a fact of the OwnerSession model, or transient input outside Registry's domain records?
options: An OwnerSession fact
Transient input outside the domain models
A separate temporary upload model
open_points.default_guess: An OwnerSession fact because M11 is the later changed text.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession import-file lifecycle
open_points.text: “the import file uploaded in it, each kept until used, replaced or the session ends”
open_points.question: Which action creates or replaces the stored file, which action reads it, and what event counts as its use and removes it?
options: A separate upload action stores or replaces it; any import attempt consumes it
A separate upload action stores or replaces it; only a successful import consumes it
The confirmed import request both uploads and uses it
open_points.default_guess: A separate owner-interface upload stores or replaces it, the confirmed import reads it, and only a successful import consumes it.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request instant
open_points.text: “changed by the owner's requests: the instant of its last request”
open_points.question: Which requests move the last-request instant: every authenticated HTTP request, only reads and changes corresponding to product actions, or only state-changing owner actions?
options: Every authenticated owner-interface request
Every owner product-action request, including reads
Only state-changing owner actions

open_points.subject: OwnerSession persistence across interruption
open_points.text: “Temporary runtime state; never a durable record beyond its life” does not say whether the newly added pending confirmations and uploaded import file survive a Registry restart while the session has not expired or signed out.
open_points.question: Does a Registry restart end every OwnerSession, or must the session and its newly added mutable facts survive restarts until normal session end?
options: Restart ends all owner sessions
Sessions and all their facts survive restart
The session survives but pending confirmations and uploaded files do not

open_points.subject: OwnerSession disclosure classes
open_points.text: “every other fact of every model … the owner session” is `business_confidential`, but M11 now makes “the import file uploaded in it” a fact even though an import file carries customer, object and project `personal_data`.
open_points.question: What disclosure class applies to the uploaded import file and to pending confirmation values when they contain personal-data fields?
options: Classify those facts as `personal_data` when their contents include it
Keep the OwnerSession facts `business_confidential` and treat file contents as outside the model
Prohibit pending values and stored uploads from containing personal-data values
open_points.default_guess: Treat the uploaded file and any pending values containing such fields as `personal_data`.
